libs.note:
BH-3949 (BH-3943 item 1): park a ticket the call-guard keeps refusing. bin/triage-shard.sh's `call-guard repeat` arm calls triage_park_on_refusal; once the D1 call_guard row for that ticket's fingerprint has refused_since_reset >= TRIAGE_REFUSED_PARK_AFTER, one triage_state PUT stamps verdict=hold with verdict_hash = the row's input_hash, so bin/triage-state.py decide answers `skip unchanged:hold` until TRIAGE_PARK_RECHECK_S passes or the board moves the hash. One warn lane-alert per park (marker state/triage-park/

/.), one `triage-park: N parked (KEYS)` line per tick from the last line of rt_scope in bin/lib/rt/scope.sh (before rt_shards; shards.sh stays unedited, BH-3418). Fail-open: an unreadable read parks nothing. Applied by the lib itself through lib_env_apply triage-park . Doc: docs/CALL-GUARD.md.

knobs.note: Call-guard refusals of one ticket fingerprint (refused_since_reset, last 24h) before the ticket is parked. 0 = never park, and the tick line is off too. Code default 3, read as ${TRIAGE_REFUSED_PARK_AFTER:-3}; with no settings row the env value answers, and a non-integer falls back to 3.

How long a park holds on an unchanged board: next_recheck_at = now + this. Any board change moves input_hash and unparks sooner. Code default 604800 (7 days), read as ${TRIAGE_PARK_RECHECK_S:-604800}; with no settings row the env value answers, and a non-integer falls back to 604800.
